# Clean the filter

[All care guides](README.md)

## Roomba 600 and 700 series

![Clean the filter](../img/bin_600_900--filter.svg)

**What it does**

The filter keeps fine dust in the bin. Once its pleats are clogged, suction drops and the robot picks up less.

**How to**

1. Press the bin release and pull the bin out of the robot.
2. Release the filter by pressing it down, then lift it out.
3. Tap it against the inside of a waste bin until no more dust falls out. Do not brush the pleats.
4. Put the filter back and slide the bin in until it clicks.

> **Note** Never wash a paper filter or let it get wet: once wet, it no longer filters.

## Roomba 800 and 900 series

![Clean the filter](../img/bin_600_900--filter.svg)

**What it does**

The filter keeps fine dust in the bin. Once its pleats are clogged, suction drops and the robot picks up less.

**How to**

1. Press the bin release, take the bin out and empty it.
2. Press the tab of the filter door and lift the door.
3. Pull the filter out by its yellow tab and tap it against the inside of a waste bin until no more dust falls out.
4. Put the filter back, close the filter door and slide the bin in until it clicks.

> **Note** Never wash a paper filter or let it get wet: once wet, it no longer filters.

## Roomba e, i and j series, Combo j

![Clean the filter](../img/bin_eij--filter.svg)

**What it does**

The filter keeps fine dust in the bin. Once its pleats are clogged, suction drops and the robot picks up less.

**How to**

1. Press the bin release on the back of the robot and take the bin out.
2. Open the bin door over a waste bin and empty the bin.
3. Grip the filter at its sides, pull it out to the left and tap it against the inside of the waste bin until no more dust falls out.
4. Put the filter back and slide the bin into its guide until it clicks.

> **Note** Never wash a paper filter or let it get wet: once wet, it no longer filters.

## Roomba s series

![Clean the filter](../img/bin_s--filter.svg)

**What it does**

The filter keeps fine dust in the bin. Once its pleats are clogged, suction drops and the robot picks up less.

**How to**

1. Press the release on the lid, open it and lift the bin out by its handle.
2. Hold the bin over a waste bin and press its release to empty it.
3. Open the filter door, pull the filter out by its loop and tap it against the inside of the waste bin.
4. Put the filter back and close the filter door: it only closes with the filter seated correctly. Put the bin back.

> **Note** Never wash a paper filter or let it get wet: once wet, it no longer filters.

## Prime robots and other models

![Clean the filter](../img/bin_eij--filter.svg)

**What it does**

The filter keeps fine dust in the bin. Once its pleats are clogged, suction drops and the robot picks up less.

**How to**

1. Press the bin release and take the bin out of the robot.
2. Lift the filter out by its tab.
3. Tap it against the inside of a waste bin until no more dust falls out. Do not brush the pleats.
4. Put the filter back with the pleats facing the same way, and slide the bin in until it clicks.

> **Note** Never wash a paper filter or let it get wet: once wet, it no longer filters.
